ov: The God of Mischief slips through time anomalies working with the Time Variance Authority.
Wanda Maximoff traps a suburban town in classic sitcom decades to process unbearable grief.

t: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
ov: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes face the Flag Smashers to honor Captain America’s shield.
Clint Barton mentors Kate Bishop in New York during Christmas while confronting his Ronin past.
Gift shop clerk Steven Grant discovers his dissociative identity disorder and ancient Egyptian avatar Marc Spector.
Jersey City teen Kamala Khan gains cosmic hard-light powers connected to her South Asian ancestry.
Hulk: Attorney at Law – Jennifer Walters balances superhuman legal defense cases with her 6-foot-7 green persona.
Nick Fury uncovers a faction of shape-shifting Skrulls infiltrating Earth's highest defense offices.
Maya Lopez returns to her Oklahoma roots while pursued by Wilson Fisk's criminal syndicate.
Agatha Harkness navigates the perilous Witches' Road to reclaim her stripped magic.
Blind lawyer Matt Murdock fights Wilson Fisk and the Hand in Hell's Kitchen as a masked vigilante.
A cynical private investigator with superhuman strength confronts her mind-controlling tormentor, Kilgrave.
A bulletproof ex-con defends Harlem against corrupt politicians and street crime lords.
Danny Rand returns to New York after 15 years armed with the glowing mystical power of the Iron Fist.
Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, and Iron Fist unite to save New York from destruction.
Frank Castle wages an unrelenting military-grade crusade to avenge the murder of his family.
Matt Murdock and Mayor Wilson Fisk clash anew over the legal and criminal soul of New York.
Phil Coulson leads a mobile tactical team investigating classified global superhuman phenomena.
Peggy Carter balances administrative post-war SSR tasks with covert operations for Howard Stark.
Six teenagers discover their wealthy parents belong to a villainous occult syndicate called the Pride.
Two teens from different walks of life discover their newly awakened complementary powers.
Royal superhuman family members are exiled from their lunar city to Hawaii following a military coup.
David Haller uncovers that his diagnosed schizophrenia is actually world-altering psychic power.
An ordinary family goes on the run after discovering their children possess active mutant genes.
Corrupt corporate superheroes owned by Vought are countered by a raw, unhinged civilian black-ops squad.
College-age supes at Godolkin University uncover sinister laboratory experiments inside The Woods.
Mark Grayson discovers his superhero father Omni-Man hides a brutal alien conquest secret.
Christopher Smith joins Project Butterfly to eliminate parasitic alien invaders threatening the world.
Masked police officers and white supremacists clash in Tulsa under the legacy of Dr. Manhattan.
Morpheus, the King of Dreams, escapes a century of imprisonment to restore his decaying realm.
Two teenage ghosts and a psychic medium solve supernatural murders on Earth.
A half-human, half-deer hybrid boy journeys across a post-pandemic ruined world to find his mother.
Estranged adopted sibling superheroes reunite to solve their father's death and stop the apocalypse.
The bored Lord of Hell abandons his throne to run a Los Angeles piano bar and assist LAPD homicides.
Detective Jim Gordon navigates a corrupt city as young Bruce Wayne witnesses his parents' murder.
Oliver Queen returns from five years stranded on a hostile island to clean up Starling City as a hooded archer.
Forensic scientist Barry Allen gains superhuman speed, battling metahumans across Central City.
Superman's cousin Kara Zor-El embraces her Kryptonian abilities to protect National City.
Time traveler Rip Hunter recruits an eccentric team of heroes and villains across historical timelines.
A retired superhero high school principal puts on his electrical suit again to save his neighborhood.
Armed with military training and bat-gear, Ryan Wilder defends Gotham's vulnerable streets.
Clark Kent and Lois Lane navigate modern parenting stress and small-town living in Smallville.
Dick Grayson steps out of Batman's shadow to lead a team of traumatized young meta heroes.
Disfigured social outcasts with bizarre superpowers investigate bizarre cosmic anomalies.
CDC doctor Abby Arcane investigates a deadly swamp-borne virus in Louisiana harboring an avatar of nature.
Alfred Pennyworth establishes a private security firm in 1960s London before serving Bruce Wayne.
Superman’s grandfather Seg-El fights to restore honor to the House of El and save his world.
Demon hunter John Constantine balances his damned soul while protecting humanity from rising darkness.
A West Texas preacher possessed by an otherworldly entity travels across America to literally find God.
Animated shorts exploring the darkly violent, unethical corners of the Vought universe.
First-generation aging superheroes struggle to pass the moral torch to their disillusioned children.
Three siblings unlock reality-bending magical keys inside their ancestral family manor.
A single mother protects her young son as he develops unpredictable superhero telekinesis.
An orphaned quadriplegic girl wakes up in a morgue with a divine angel's halo embedded in her back.

t: I Am Not Okay with This
ov: A teenage girl navigates high-school anxieties alongside sudden, volatile telekinetic outbursts.
In a world where everyone gets a superpower at 18, a 25-year-old struggles with having none.
Homicide detectives investigate crimes involving humans with superhuman abilities called "Powers".
Ordinary people across the globe discover they have abilities and unite to save a cheerleader and the world.
A new generation of extraordinary beings goes into hiding as government agencies hunt them down.
Monkey – A wronged Japanese macaque guided by the ghost of an American assassin takes down Tokyo’s yakuza.
Noble families feud for the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient icy menace marches south.
The Targaryen civil war, known as the Dance of the Dragons, fractures royal dynasty rule.

t: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
ov: The forging of the Rings of Power during Middle-earth’s Second Age against rising Sauron.
Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster hunter, navigates a continent where humans often prove more beastly.
The creation of the first prototype Witcher and the celestial Conjunction of the Spheres.
Moiraine guides five young villagers, one of whom is the reincarnated Dragon Reborn.
Orphan mapmaker Alina Starkov unleashes radiant sun-summoning power capable of cleaving the Shadow Fold.
A human detective and a refugee fae rekindle a dangerous affair amid Victorian fantasy serial killings.
Lyra's search for a kidnapped friend uncovers cosmic Dust and parallel multiverse worlds.
A modern demigod son of Poseidon is accused of stealing Zeus’s master lightning bolt.
Monkey D. Luffy sets sail with his ragtag Straw Hat pirate crew in search of the legendary treasure.
Young airbender Aang masters all four elemental arts to stop the destructive Fire Nation.
A novice knight is entrusted with carrying a secret letter to the monarch to prevent catastrophe.
Nimue embraces her destiny to wield the ancestral sword Excalibur before Arthurian legend emerges.
Elves and humans embark on a perilous quest to protect the ancient Ellcrys tree from demons.
Fairies at Alfea boarding school master elemental magic while facing ancient Burned Ones.
An aspiring sorcerer leads an unlikely group of young heroes on a rescue mission beyond the Shattered Dunes.
Shadow Moon is released from prison and hired as bodyguard to Mr. Wednesday, an incarnation of Odin.
An angel and a demon who enjoy their comfortable Earthly lifestyle team up to stop Armageddon.
Roman legions invade the mystical shores of Britain ruled by wild Celtic warrior queens and Druids.
Talon, the sole survivor of the Blackblood race, tracks her family’s killers to a lawless frontier fortress.
Young wizard Merlin conceals his magical arts while serving the stubborn Prince Arthur in Camelot.
A modern man washed ashore in ancient mythological Atlantis encounters Hercules and Pythagoras.
Robin of Locksley returns from the Crusades to lead outlaw resistance against the Sheriff of Nottingham.
Woodsman Richard Cypher is guided by a wizard to wield the Sword of Truth against a tyrant.
Fairy-tale characters are trapped in our real-world Maine town with their memories wiped by a curse.
Students admitted to Brakebills University discover the secret magical kingdom from childhood books is real and deadly.
A historian witch discovers an enchanted alchemical manuscript, partnering with a geneticist vampire.
Victorian women suddenly gifted with abnormal supernatural abilities champion London's outcasts.
A modern police officer is swept by a tornado into a dark, technologically divided land of Oz.
The legendary mercenary warrior defends the Great Hall of Herot from Grendel creatures.
King Arthur ascends to the throne amid political manipulation by the sorceress Morgan le Fay.
Paris and Helen’s forbidden love triggers the ten-year Greek military siege of Troy.
The mythical Greek demigod travels ancient landscapes defending mortals from monsters.
A reformed warrior woman and her companion Gabrielle seek redemption across mythical lands.
A Thracian gladiator is forced into brutal Ludus arena slavery before igniting an empire revolt.
The rise of the House of Batiatus and arena champion Gannicus before Spartacus's arrival.
Rebel gladiators wage guerrilla warfare against Roman legions sent to slaughter them.
Spartacus faces the ruthless financial and military might of Marcus Licinius Crassus.
Soldiers Lucius Vorenus and Titus Pullo witness the death of the Roman Republic and Caesar's rise.
Livia Drusilla navigates political assassinations and blood feuds to become Rome’s most influential empress.
The Knights Templar search for the lost Holy Grail as King Philip IV plots their downfall.
Saxon-born Uhtred of Bebbanburg, raised by Danish Vikings, fights to reclaim his ancestral birthright.

t: The Last Kingdom: Seven Kings Must Die
ov: Uhtred fights to unite England following the death of King Edward.
Ragnar Lothbrok rises from simple farmer to legendary Norse king raiding England and France.
Leif Erikson, Freydís Eiríksdóttir, and Harald Hardrada forge legendary paths as the Viking Age wanes.
Deadpan dark-comedy everyday life and political schemes of an 8th-century Viking village.
Declan Harp campaigns against the Hudson's Bay Company's corrupt fur trade monopoly in 1700s Canada.
Captain Flint and John Silver fight for the survival of New Providence Island during piracy's golden age.
Legendary pirate Blackbeard commands an outlaw haven on Santa Campana using high-seas espionage.
Aristocrat Stede Bonnet abandons high society to become an eccentric gentleman pirate alongside Blackbeard.
The young Italian merchant navigates Kublai Khan's imperial court, martial arts, and Chinese conquests.
A WWII combat nurse is mysteriously swept back in time to 1743 Scotland, meeting Highland warrior Jamie Fraser.
Ross Poldark returns from the American War of Independence to rebuild his ruined Cornish tin-mining estate.
Charlotte Heywood moves to a developing seaside resort town in this adaptation of Jane Austen's final unfinished work.
A 14th-century knight vows to lay down his sword, but is forced to take up the bloody executioner's axe.
Young Leonardo da Vinci uses innovative engineering and inventions amid Renaissance Vatican politics.
Rodrigo Borgia schemes and bribes his way into becoming Pope Alexander VI, building a dynastic empire.
The banking dynasty funds Renaissance art while fighting political rivals for Florentine control.
Three ruthless women fight for the English throne during the turbulent Wars of the Roses.
The union of Elizabeth of York and King Henry VII aims to bridge fractured House divisions.
Catherine of Aragon arrives in England determined to secure her royal destiny as queen.
Zeus grows paranoid over a wrinkle on his forehead as humans realize the Greek gods are self-absorbed tyrants.
Jules Verne’s Captain Nemo escapes colonial imprisonment to build his legendary high-tech submarine.
A Germanic officer torn between Roman legions and his tribal roots leads the Battle of the Teutoburg Forest.
The disappearance of a young boy uncovers secret lab experiments and the dark Upside Down.
A vault dweller leaves her underground nuclear bunker to traverse the bizarre, violent California wasteland.
Master Chief John-117 battles the alien Covenant while discovering his humanity through an ancient artifact.
Synthetic android theme park hosts awaken to sentience and revolt against their human creators.
Smuggler Joel escorts immune teen Ellie across a ruined America infected by fungal cordyceps.
Thousands live inside a massive 144-floor subterranean silo bound by strict rules regarding the toxic outside world.
Mathematician Hari Seldon uses psychohistory to predict the fall of the Galactic Empire and preserve knowledge.
Scientists across continents confront an extraterrestrial threat triggered by a 1960s secret Chinese transmission.
Twilight Zone-style standalone anthologies examining the disturbing, unintended consequences of modern technologies.
Takeshi Kovacs is resleeved into a new body 250 years later to solve a wealthy immortal’s murder.
Centuries after a virus blinded humanity, twin infants born with the mythic gift of sight cause tribal warfare.
The Robinson family's exploratory spacecraft crashes on an uncharted alien world alongside an alien robot.
A hardened detective and a rogue ship crew uncover an alien protomolecule threatening Solar System politics.
A lone bounty hunter traverses the outer reaches of the galaxy protecting the Force-sensitive Child, Grogu.
Cassian Andor transforms from a selfish scavenger into the passionate architect of the Rebel Alliance.
Former Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging imperial threat posed by Grand Admiral Thrawn.
Wan Kenobi – In hiding on Tatooine, Obi-Wan embarks on a dangerous rescue mission pursued by Darth Vader and Inquisitors.
The legendary armored bounty hunter takes over the Tatooine criminal empire once run by Jabba the Hutt.
Four lost children make a discovery on their home planet and journey across the dangerous galaxy.
A Jedi Master investigates a series of shocking murders during the High Republic era.
Genetically mutated Clone Force 99 takes on mercenary missions across the newly formed Empire.
Alternate timeline history where the Soviet Union beats America to the Moon, fueling an endless space race.
Siblings follow their father’s footsteps to uncover their family’s connection to Godzilla and Monarch.
An extraterrestrial invasion unfolds in real time through the perspectives of ordinary people across five continents.
A physicist is abducted into an alternate reality of his own life and must fight parallel versions to return.
Employees undergo a medical procedure separating their work memories from their personal non-work memories.
A young woman testing a futuristic VR headset discovers she is piloting a physical avatar in 2099 London.
An elderly couple keeps a secret underground chamber that inexplicably opens onto a deserted alien planet.
A family in occupied Los Angeles must choose between collaborating with alien transitional authorities or resisting.
History professor Tom Mason leads civilian resistance fighters following a catastrophic extraterrestrial invasion.
A century after a nuclear apocalypse, 100 juvenile delinquents are sent back to Earth to test its habitability.
Fifteen years after an unexplained worldwide blackout disables all electricity, survivors battle regional militias.
Passengers aboard Montego Air Flight 828 land safely, only to discover five and a half years have passed.
Operatives send their consciousness back to the 21st century into host bodies to prevent human extinction.
Eight strangers across different global cities discover they are mentally and emotionally linked telepathically.
